stories.title: Man stole Mercedes G-Wagon after convincing Tampa hotel valet the car was his: affidavit
stories.summary: Police say Payton Strain, 27, approached the valet at the Marriot Waterside and got into the G-Wagon, acting as if the car was his before driving off.

stories.title: Sarasota launches new parking validation program aimed at helping downtown businesses attract customers

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel rush: 3 tips to help you get through Tampa Bay airports faster
stories.summary: New services and some extra preparation can help expedite the process for travelers this year.

stories.title: Books, vinyl and the big impact of shopping small at St. Pete’s Shopapalooza

stories.summary: The service is available for residents and business owners within the sheriff's office's jurisdiction.
